result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major truncated restaurant name in the Fastest section and a minor cut-off category chip on the right edge.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word under the third card in 'Fastest near you', so the full name is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure cards and text have enough width/ellipsis handling so names are fully legible.

issues.description: The category filter row ends with a partially visible empty/white chip on the far right, which looks like a broken or incomplete control.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal padding or fade masking so only complete chips are shown, or make the trailing partial chip clearly part of intentional scroll without looking blank.
